metadata.title: clip_grad_norm_ fails when parameters are on different devices (1.5 regression)

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



In pytorch 1.4, `clip_grad_norm_` worked even when parameters were on different devices. Pytorch 1.5 no longer supports this, due to #32020.

trigger_conditions.condition: Creating neural network parameters and gradients located on different devices and applying gradient aggregation or clipping operations that require consistent device placement.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Model parameters and their gradients are located on different devices (e.g., cuda:0 and cuda:1) when clip_grad_norm_ is called.

failure_behavior.description: Model parameters and their gradients are located on different devices (e.g., cuda:0 and cuda:1) when clip_grad_norm_ is called.
